existing_validators.description: Checks first 5 bytes of output file equal b'%PDF-'. Also checks min_bytes threshold.
usable_for_deferred_types: DocConverter (if DOCX output, use xlsx_check instead)

existing_validators.description: Checks image file format headers: PNG (0x89 0x50 0x4E 0x47), JPEG (0xFF 0xD8), BMP (0x42 0x4D), TIFF (0x49 0x49 or 0x4D 0x4D). Falls back to non-empty file check for other formats.
Checks HTML output file for <html> tag and <table> tag presence.
Validates XLSX output as a valid ZIP file containing xl/workbook.xml. Counts ZIP entries.
usable_for_deferred_types: DocConverter (DOCX output variant via ZIP+word/document.xml check)

existing_validators.description: Validates JSON output file is parseable. Checks array vs. object shape.
Validates text/CSV output file is UTF-8 readable. Checks content_contains and content_not_contains from expected-output.json.

validator_gaps.description: Validator for DOC/DOCX output from PDF-to-document conversion. Two sub-variants needed: (1) DOCX output — reuse xlsx_check pattern checking for word/document.xml inside ZIP, (2) Legacy DOC output — check OLE2 compound document magic bytes (D0 CF 11 E0 A1 B1 1A E1).
validator_gaps.implementation_approach: Add a new check in _validate_xlsx_output (or a new _validate_docx_output function) that looks for word/document.xml in the ZIP namelist instead of xl/workbook.xml. Extend the extension dispatch in validate_output_file_semantic to route .docx to this new check.

proposed_implementation.logic: Open as zipfile.ZipFile; check 'word/document.xml' in namelist. For .doc: check header bytes D0 CF 11 E0.

validator_gaps.description: Light-weight PDF/A conformance marker check. Full PDF/A validation requires specialized tools (VeraPDF). Minimum viable check: verify %PDF- header (pdf_magic_byte already covers this) + search for XMP conformance metadata block.
validator_gaps.implementation_approach: After pdf_magic_byte check, read first 4KB of file and search for b'pdfa:conformance' or b'pdfaid:conformance' XMP namespace strings. If found, report as conformance_marker_found=True (bonus check). Basic healing only requires pdf_magic_byte passing.

proposed_implementation.logic: Run pdf_magic_byte first. Optionally scan binary content for XMP namespace marker b'pdfaid:part'. This is a best-effort check — not required to pass for initial healing.
proposed_implementation.note: For Healing Wave A, pdf_magic_byte alone is sufficient for PdfAConverter healing. The conformance check is a future enhancement.

validator_gaps.description: Validator for ResultCollection output where results are StringResult (text content) rather than file outputs. Pattern established by TextExtractor pilot: cast ResultCollection[0] to StringResult, check .Text contains expected string.
validator_gaps.implementation_approach: The TextExtractor validation pattern is already in production code. For PdfExtractor, add per_type_constraints documenting the same StringResult/FileResult handling. No new validator code needed if PdfExtractor outputs StringResult — reuse TextExtractor expected-output.json pattern with content_contains check.

proposed_implementation.approach: Reuse stdout validation (validate_output function) with must_contain patterns in expected-output.json. If PdfExtractor outputs files to ResultCollection, pdf_magic_byte applies to those files. No new validator code strictly required.
proposed_implementation.note: Needs API verification: does PdfExtractor.Process() produce StringResult or FileResult entries? If StringResult, stdout validation already handles it. If FileResult with PDF output, pdf_magic_byte applies.

validator_gaps.description: When PDF-to-image conversion outputs multiple files (one per page), the current _validate_image_output checks a single file path. Need to validate ResultCollection entries where each entry is a FileResult pointing to an image file.
validator_gaps.implementation_approach: The existing _validate_image_output works correctly on individual file paths. The integration layer (runner.py / bridge) needs to iterate ResultCollection entries and call validate_output_file_semantic on each FileResult path. This is an integration-level change, not a new validator function.

proposed_implementation.approach: In expected-output.json for image-output types, specify result_collection_validation: true + expected_result_count: 1 (for single-page input) + each_result_extension: .png. The runner validates each ResultCollection entry.
proposed_implementation.note: For Healing Wave B, validate only that at least 1 image file exists in output dir and passes image_format check. Full per-page count validation is a future enhancement.

validator_gaps.description: TableGenerator output is a newly created PDF. pdf_magic_byte is sufficient for basic healing. Optional enhancement: extract text from the generated PDF to verify table content appears.
validator_gaps.implementation_approach: For Healing Wave B, pdf_magic_byte + min_bytes check is sufficient. No new validator needed. The 'fixture' for TableGenerator is the builder code, not an input file.

proposed_implementation.approach: pdf_magic_byte validator is sufficient for initial healing. Per expected-output.json pattern, set min_bytes to reasonable threshold (e.g., 500) to confirm non-empty PDF generated.
proposed_implementation.note: No new validator code needed for Wave B healing of TableGenerator.

validator_gaps.description: Validator for encrypted/decrypted PDF output. For basic healing, pdf_magic_byte is sufficient. For semantic validation: encrypted PDF should contain /Encrypt entry in PDF cross-reference; decrypted PDF should not.
validator_gaps.implementation_approach: For Healing Wave C, pdf_magic_byte is sufficient. Optional enhancement: read PDF binary and search for b'/Encrypt' token in first 1KB to confirm encryption dict presence. This is a heuristic check — not authoritative but sufficient for smoke testing.

proposed_implementation.approach: For initial healing: pdf_magic_byte only. Enhanced validator: scan binary for /Encrypt token. Document as 'encryption_marker_check' in expected-output.json.
proposed_implementation.note: The primary challenge for Security is the fixture (FG-007), not the validator.

validator_gaps.description: Validator to confirm digital signature was added to PDF. Check for /Sig annotation or /AcroForm /Sig structure in PDF binary.
validator_gaps.implementation_approach: Scan PDF binary for b'/Sig' token or b'adbe.pkcs7' OID string to confirm signature dict present. Heuristic but sufficient for smoke testing. Full cryptographic signature verification would require pyhanko or similar library.

proposed_implementation.approach: Binary scan for /Sig and /AcroForm presence. pdf_magic_byte check passes first. The signature-specific check is bonus validation.
proposed_implementation.note: For Wave D healing, pdf_magic_byte + no-error-in-stdout is the minimum bar. Signature presence check is a bonus.

validator_gaps.description: Validator to confirm RFC 3161 timestamp token embedded in PDF. Check for /DocTimeStamp annotation.
validator_gaps.implementation_approach: Binary scan for b'/DocTimeStamp' or b'1.2.840.113549.1.9.16.1.4' OID (RFC 3161 id-smime-ct-TSTInfo). Heuristic only.

proposed_implementation.approach: Binary scan for /DocTimeStamp token. However, the primary blocker for Timestamp is the TSA server fixture gap (FG-009), not the validator. Validator implementation is secondary.
proposed_implementation.note: Cannot heal Timestamp until FG-009 (TSA server/stub) is resolved.

validator_gaps.description: Validator for form field export/import round-trip. For FormExporter (JSON variant): json_check already exists. For FormImporter: pdf_magic_byte on output PDF. Optional round-trip check: export-then-verify field values.
validator_gaps.implementation_approach: For FormExporter JSON: existing json_check + content_contains check for expected field value in JSON output. For FormImporter: pdf_magic_byte on output. No new validator code strictly needed.

proposed_implementation.approach: Reuse json_check for FormExporter JSON output. Use text_check for CSV output. Use pdf_magic_byte for FormImporter output. All existing validators apply.
proposed_implementation.note: The primary challenge for Form types is the AcroForm fixture (FG-005, FG-006), not the validators.

types_with_no_new_validator_needed.reason: pdf_magic_byte validator already covers these types' output format. Primary blocker is fixture code, not validator code.

validator_reuse_opportunities.note: The single most impactful existing validator — covers all PDF-output types in the deferred set.
All four image converters (Jpeg, Png, Tiff, PdfToImage) plus ImageExtractor can use this without modification.
XlsConverter (XLSX variant) and DocConverter (DOCX variant — needs word/document.xml check instead of xl/workbook.xml) can leverage this with minor adaptation.
